name: VACCINE STORAGE REFRIGERATOR
desc: The INNOLAB INSTRUMENTS Vaccine Storage Refrigerator is designed for highly safe storage of vaccines, medicines, and insulin between 2°C to 8°C. It features a smart undercounter design, full-length double layered toughened glass door with frost-free feature, anti-condensation, and an in-built tamper-proof data recording facility.
features: Small undercounter size that occupies low space
Tamper-proof data recording & storage via USB
Visual and audible low/high temperature & power failure alarms
Fully length frost free toughened glass door with lock & key

specifications.Data Recording: Tamper-proof temperature & event recording with USB port
specifications.Alarms: Temperature low & high, sensor failure, power failure, door open, low battery
